overview_description.description: OurCrowd sources and evaluates startup deals and venture funds across multiple sectors to offer direct investment options to its network. Its professionals conduct due diligence and provide market insights for each presented opportunity to assist users in building diversified portfolios. Beyond capital allocation, the entity facilitates strategic introductions and mentorship to support the growth of its portfolio companies. The platform allows for investment across various currencies and includes a reporting system for tracking performance and lifecycle updates.

about_short_description.short_description: OurCrowd is a digital investment platform and venture capital firm that provides access to private market opportunities.

product.name: Startup Investment Platform
product.description: A platform enabling accredited investors to invest in pre-vetted early-stage startups alongside institutional investors.

product.name: Venture Fund Investments
product.description: Investment opportunities in targeted venture capital funds managed or selected by OurCrowd.

product.name: Alternative Asset Investments
product.description: Access to alternative investment opportunities including private equity, private credit, and other non-traditional asset classes.

product.name: Portfolio Reserve Account
product.description: A pre-funded investment account that allows investors to quickly allocate capital to selected investment opportunities.

product.name: Foreign Currency Exchange Service
product.description: A service enabling investors to convert local currencies to US dollars for investment funding through a partnership with Airwallex Group.
